candidates.name: Existing The Boss UAR gateway model-source adapter
candidates.fit_for_gap: A live liter-llm served-alias list and protected gateway credential already exist in the trusted main process.

evidence.claim: The Boss UarModelSourceAdapter.ts reads /v1/models; uarModelAssignments.ts resolves gateway run credentials.

risks: A listed alias can still fail during a real request.
candidates.decision_rationale: Expose and persist this existing model route through create and edit instead of implementing another gateway.

candidates.name: Existing UAR configured-provider model source
candidates.fit_for_gap: UAR has a direct model-provider catalog and a matching persisted assignment variant.

evidence.claim: The Boss UarModelSourceAdapter.ts reads UAR /api/uar/providers; UAR runtime credentials.rs binds an exact host credential/model.

risks: Direct UAR provider credentials are managed separately from the liter gateway.
candidates.decision_rationale: Retain as an explicit source instead of forcing all UAR inference through liter.

build_required.need: Create/edit assignment controls and truthful effective-model presentation
build_required.why_no_candidate: The existing shared agent wizard and edit dialog do not expose or persist the UAR assignment.
